ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity dark charcoal pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity pigmentation zone concentrated around the median notch and extending along the trailing edges in a 'T' formation. Large, contiguous high-intensity white fields occupy the lateral and proximal regions of both lobes, with minor dark mottling observed on the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 48 degrees and a vertical depth occupying 12% of the central fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge with peak amplitudes of 5-15 pixels. The serrations are most pronounced and irregular at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary sweep follows a convex arc from the notch toward the tips, with local irregularities due to edge serrations and tip encrustations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular clusters (barnacle colonies) are detected at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Scattered circular pale scars are visible on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical, dark linear pixel disruptions are visible on the right lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) at the lobe terminals creates a jagged, non-linear silhouette. Multiple small V-shaped nicks are present along the trailing edge of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated dark vertical streak is present in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe's white pigmentation field.
